versions.changelog:
## Machine Tempo 1.0

First release.

- Kegs and preserves jars finish their goods faster: wine, juice, beer, pale ale, mead, coffee, green tea, vinegar, jelly, pickles, caviar and aged roe.
- Choose the speed in the config: 1.0 (normal), 1.25, 1.5 (default) or 2.0.
- Only the processing time changes. Inputs, outputs and prices stay as they are.

## Machine Tempo 1.1

Cheese presses and looms join in.

- Cheese presses make cheese and goat cheese faster, looms weave cloth faster.
- They use the same speed setting as kegs and preserves jars: at 1.5 (default) cheese takes about 2 hours 15 minutes instead of 3 hours 20 minutes, cloth about 2 hours 40 minutes instead of 4. At 2.0 both take half the time.
- Your speed setting carries over. Inputs, outputs, quality and prices stay as they are, and the loom's chance of double cloth from quality wool is untouched.

## Machine Tempo 1.2

The settings are now in German too.

- The speed setting has a readable name, description and value names in the in-game config menu (Generic Mod Config Menu): "Machine speed" in English (from "Normal speed (1.0)" to "Twice as fast (2.0)"), "Maschinentempo" in German (from "Normales Tempo (1,0)" to "Doppelt so schnell (2,0)"). Players with the game set to German see the setting in German; everyone else keeps the English one.
- Same machines, same speeds; your setting carries over and nothing else changes.
